QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Find the Mastercore!
QuestInfo.0: You've shot down a fair number of the #o9400254# recon drones. Press on to reclaim the #t4032151#.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you've eliminated the #o9400254# recon drones, you've got time to determine which #o9400253# is carrying the #t4032151#. How to determine that? By wrecking them all until you find the right one.
QuestInfo.2: You found the #t4032151#! But something doesn't feel right...
